DESCRIPTION: At the start of its turn, lose HP equal to its Bleed stacks, then remove #b50% of its Bleed. DeepWound prevents Bleed from being removed this turn. When a Bleeding creature takes unblocked attack damage, it gains #b1 Bleed.
Every #b5 Sin you have grants #b1 Debt.
Each stack of Debt makes you take #b10% more damage. When a Debt application is blocked by Artifact, lose %%SIN_PER_DEBT%% Sin for each 1 Debt blocked.
You cannot gain [E] unless you fully remove all of your Debt. Removed at the end of your turn.
